jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Make is the leading visual platform for anyone to design, build, and automate anything—from tasks and workflows to apps and systems—without the need for coding skills. We are headquartered in the flourishing tech hub of Prague, Czech Republic, and our teams are spread across the USA, UK, Germany, France, Canada, India and Chile, among other locations.

We are seeking a highly motivated Sales Analyst to join our team. The successful candidate will be a great communicator and collaborator, with a passion for using data and insights to drive action. The role will continue to build our data-driven approach to Go To Market & Sales through efforts including: clear, insightful reporting, proactive identification of new opportunities, and closely monitoring and evaluating performance.

Responsibilities:

You will be the primary data and analytics business partner to the Sales and Go To Market teams, working closely with the group to understand and identify needs. In this roles you will:
•... Development of pre-sales and post-sales intelligence, including dashboards, reports and insights.
• Proactively interpret data to provide insights and identify areas for improvement
• Provide data and ad-hoc analyses to the sales team and management as needed
• Cooperate with our Go To Market Operations team in facilitating and driving regular cadencies (reviews of Pipeline, QBRs, Targets etc.) as well as improving overall sales funnel intelligence
• Work with cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement and drive critical thinking to challenge the status quo

What we are looking for:
• Fluent in English with great collaboration and communication skills to work with others across the business to turn data to insights to drive action
• A proactive approach and genuine curiosity to understand and share what the data means.
• Good technical skills and experience, comfortable with spreadsheet analysis, SQL code, and building dashboards.
• Eager to use new technologies, tackle new challenges, flourish in a fast-paced environment and contribute to our data-driven culture.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in Data / Business Analytics / Sales Operations / Consulting
• A plus if you have experience with:
• Sales, Customer Success, and Go-To-Market processes and metrics (i.e ARR, Churn, ACV, Revenue and Pipeline Conversion Rates, etc) a plus
• Understanding of the typical SaaS customer lifecycle journey from acquisition to retention and expansion a plus
• CRM tools and their Databases (like Salesforce, SAP or Pipedrive) and Customer care tools (like FreshDesk, Custify etc.)

What we offer:
• 📈 RSUs grant in a rapidly growing company raising its value every day
• 💸 Annual bonus
• 🌎 Multinational team with 42 nationalities creating the future of automation
• 🎓 Learning & Development plan (online language, professional courses, conference tickets and other trainings) & 2 Company Learning Days per year
• 🌳3 Company Impact Days per year
• 🍎 Notebook/Macbook and 34’’ curved monitor
• 🏝 25 days of vacation, 4 sick days, company day off on 31st December
• 🫶 10 care days to care for your loved ones
• 👨👩👧👦 Extra parental vacation (3-6 months)
• 👶 RSUs grant for a newborn child
• ☂️ Life insurance
• 🏋️ Gympass
• 💳 Meal and transportation tickets, medical insurance
• 🥳 Team buildings, parties, and company events multiple times a year
• 🏡 Flexible working hours + home office

If you are a numbers person passionate about creating data-driven insights and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we encourage you to apply for this role.

Join us on the ride!

#careeratmake

What we stand for:

🤝 We roll together - We embrace different ideas to grow together and create powerful solutions.

🚀 Customer impact first - We empower our customers to succeed, aiming for sustainable impact.

⚽ Game on! - We're explorers at heart: play is our fuel and creativity has no limits.

For more, feel free to check out our Life at Make Instagram, Meet-up page, or YouTube to get a sense of the vibe.

Make is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment and equal opportunity in all aspects of employment. We will not tolerate any unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind. We make all employment decisions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, sex, pregnancy, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, transgender status, national origin, citizenship status, religion, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable anti-discrimination laws. As a US federal contractor, we are committed to the principles of affirmative action in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Different makes us better.

Accessibility and Candidate Notices

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations Analytics
jobs_results.description:
This role is hybrid (2 days per week) in our Barcelona office

Who we're looking for:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Operations Analyst at Rover who is excited about independently owning complex, cross-functional projects from end to end. You will partner with senior business leaders on high visibility projects, relentlessly pursuing outcomes that directly influence the customer experience on the Rover platform. You will be seen as a thought leader on the team and across the organization, and should be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in identifying and solving business problems.

We want someone who is passionate about directly shaping Rover’s support experience. You should be excited about partnering with product and business leaders to identify problems in the support experience and generate solutions that scale with the business. You will be responsible for designing robust tests and sophisticated analyses that deliver strong, actionable... recommendations to improve our business. Examples of this include developing our strategy for multi-language global support, improving our self serve support experience, optimizing agent processes and workflows, assessing and improving how we measure support quality, etc.

In addition to concurrently driving several high impact cross functional projects, this person will also be responsible for creating new metrics to understand the performance of new business initiatives, developing reporting dashboards, and building data abstractions in DBT. Additionally, they will play a vital role in supporting AB testing and experimentation efforts, using statistical analysis to evaluate changes and drive meaningful change across the business.

Your Responsibilities:
• Partner with business leaders to identify and size problem areas, conduct deep and comprehensive analyses to better understand the problem and recommend solutions.
• Partner with our Operations Scalability product team to find opportunities to improve our customer experience and reduce our support costs through improving agent efficiency
• Develop strategies to both measure and optimize the organization’s efficiency, agent performance, and interactions with customers
• Serve as strategic partner and advisor to business leaders, responsible for making recommendations on investments and optimization strategies in key functional area
• Help build the team by mentoring junior team members on data manipulation and business partnering
• Support the construction of our reporting abstractions (built in dbt)

Your Qualifications:
• At least 6 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
• You are extremely comfortable with taking ambiguous issues and structuring them into crisp business problems, and using those to develop and execute on a refined project plan with clearly identified deliverables, all with relative autonomy.
• Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists
• You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
• You can independently prioritize projects based on return on investment and own the end-to-end project management for our analytics deliverables
• You are excited to help build a team and mentor junior analysts

Nice to have:
• Masters degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
• Ability to code in Python/R is a plus
• Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
• Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design

Benefits of working at Rover:
• Competitive compensation
• Permanent contract
• Pension Plan
• Meal tickets through Cobee
• Generous PTO Allowance
• Private health insurance
• Discounted Gym Membership
• Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
• Monetary help for adopting a dog plus yearly credit to use on our platform
• Flexible work hours, sometimes you’ll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we’re pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
• Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
• Regular team activities, including happy hours, game nights, and more

Who we are:

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

We believe everyone deserves the unconditional love of a pet—and at Rover, our mission is to make it easier to experience that love. Founded in 2011, the Rover app and website connect dog and cat parents with loving pet sitters and dog walkers in neighborhoods across the US, Canada, and Europe. We empower our community of trusted pet sitters and dog walkers to run their own pet care businesses on Rover with the tools and security of a global company to back them.

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, we work closely with our teams in Barcelona, San Antonio, Spokane, and remote locations. We’ve got a reputation for being a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. We're an agile, fast-growing company, and our leadership comes from some of the world's most respected tech companies.

At Rover, our furry coworkers are just as important as our human ones—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. Along with making the joys of pet parenthood more accessible, we’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming community of pet people—and that starts with our employees

jobs_results.title: Data Science (Programa Talento) con certificado de discapacidad
jobs_results.description:
¿Te apetece arrancar tu carrera profesional en Data Analytics, adquiriendo experiencia profesional y, al mismo tiempo, formación académica especializada en importante multinacional del sector bancario?

A través de este Data Science Talent Program accederás a una formación de posgrado especializada en Data Science, al mismo tiempo que te incorporas en uno de los equipos que actualmente trabajan con estas metodologías.

Como participante del programa tendrás la oportunidad de cursar un posgrado en Big Data & Analytics, creado ad hoc, en uno de los centros universitarios de referencia en este ámbito.

Ofrecemos:

- Formación remunerada con 900€ (con comedor gratuito).

- Contrato formativo con posibilidad real a indefinido.

- Incorporación en junio.

Requisitos:

- Motivación por la posición y el área.

- Estudios universitarios en cualquier rama de Ingeniería, Física, Matemáticas, Estadística o carreras técnicas como química.

- Nivel de inglés mínimo B2

- Posibilidad de compaginar... trabajo de 35 horas/semanales con un Máster en Data Science en prestigiosa Escuela de Negocios.

- Disponibilidad de incorporación en junio.

Este programa es el primer paso para iniciar tu camino en un sector en plena transformación, en el que Data Science se perfila como estratégico

jobs_results.title: Administrator /analista de datos estadísticos/as
jobs_results.description:
Description Of The Work/Tasks

Under the supervision of the survey coordinator and in close coordination with team members, the main function and duties will be the assistance to the project Workers´Exposure Survey:
• Prepare the survey data for sharing in a data repository for researchers:
• manage the different data files, in particular combine different data

files (sav and csv formats), using the relevant statistical software;
• reflect on a relevant and useful format and appropriate content for

sharing the dataset, in particular cleaning the dataset from information

that is not useful for the purpose, and considering the final size of the

dataset;
• draft a short document explaining how to use the dataset;
• Analyse the data applying relevant statistical methods and techniques:
• carry out statistical analyses according to the analysis plan defined by

the survey coordinator and team, with the view of supporting the drafting

of publications and communication outputs planned... for 2024;
• raise and discuss the advantages, drawbacks and limitations of the

methods and techniques proposed;
• contribute to the revision of the analysis plan with the supervisor and

the team members.

We expect the temporary support to regularly present the results of the work to the supervisor (orally or in writing) and to document all the steps and programs in writing, so that they could be replicated at any moment after the temporary support has left. If R is used, the main steps will need to be transcripted into SPSS syntax, as it is the main software used by the team members.

Suggestions on statistical analyses are encouraged and welcome on an on-going basis.

En Adecco creemos en la igualdad de oportunidades y apostamos por el Talento Sin Etiquetas

Requisitos

Requirements

EDUCATION:
• Degree in statistics or similar/ Grado en estadístico/a, estadístico/a

aplicada o similar.

Essential
• Very good statistical and data analysis skills.
• Very good proficiency of SPSS and/or R (or similar statistical software

or programming language).
• Experience in carrying out the tasks described above: preparing a dataset

for sharing with data users, statistical data analysis following a plan

and taking into account the output, explaining, arguing and discussing

different options for analysis, documenting the different steps carried

out.
• Detail- and quality-oriented person.
• Satisfactory knowledge of English (equivalent to B2 level).
• Capacity to work well in a team, and also independently.
• Good interpersonal skills, and adaptability skills (to different working

methods, people and areas of work).
• Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite particularly Excel and

Word.

Assets
• Experience in health statistics, epidemiology, exposure data,

occupational safety and health.
• Experience of cross-country data analysis.
• Experience of an international/multicultural environment.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Place Of Work
• Bilbao (Agency premises are in Miribilla)
• Teleworking is offered

Tendrás un contrato a través de Adecco de 4 meses de duración

Trabajarás de lunes a viernes en horario de jornada partida

Ganarás un salario de 25,95 euros brutos hora

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Shalion is a data driven company working for world class manufacturers and brands worldwide. With its Digital Shelf Optimization and Retail Media solutions, Shalion provides innovative tools that facilitate ecommerce monitoring.

We, at Shalion, enable brands to make smarter business decisions in eCommerce, based on actionable data and insights providing information on online product prices, availability, share of search, etc. in more than 800 e-retailers and 50 different countries. Our client portfolio includes industry giants such as Heineken, Diageo, and L’Oréal.

If you are a Data Analyst and want to make a difference in your professional career, this is your role! At Shalion we’ve built a modern data platform (with technologies like Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, Looker, Airbyte and Github actions) that is critical for the company revenue generation: we sell data to our customers who consume it either through our dashboards in Looker embedded or through an API.

The role

As a Senior... Data Analyst at Shalion, your responsibilities include:
• Developing and maintaining impactful dashboards and visualizations in Looker, enhancing user experience and guiding analytical paths.
• Collaborating with Product teams to shape the product roadmap based on customer feedback and market insights.
• Translating business requirements into technical tasks, ensuring timely delivery.
• Working closely with Data Engineers to expand and enhance datasets, contributing to roadmap planning.
• Ensuring data quality and consistency across dashboards.
• Facilitating workshops for tailored business solutions and translating product questions into actionable insights.

Your profile should include the following:
• 3+ years of experience working as part of a data team; preferably as a data analyst or scientist.
• Hands-on and strong working knowledge of SQL
• High experience level with modern visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau or Qlik Sense.
• Solid statistical background.
• Experience working with Data Scientists and Engineers.

Ideally you will also have:
• An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as math, physics, computer science, statistics, etc.
• Experience with market research analysis
• Experience working with a modern data warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).
• Basic knowledge of Git and command-line
• Prior experience modelling data in LookML and dbt (data build tool)
• Be fluent with one or more common data-related programming languages (Python or R)
• UX skills

Soft Skills:
• Communication: Excellent presentation and communication skills.
• Prioritization: Skillful at prioritizing tasks, gaining stakeholder buy-in, and resolving conflicts.
• Resilience: Able to thrive in ambiguous situations and enjoy problem-solving.
• Mentorship: Interest in coaching and sharing knowledge with teammates.
• Curiosity: Eagerness to learn and engage in constructive discussions.
• Quality-oriented: Can discern data quality and value code testing for growth.
• Analytical prowess: Strong problem-solving abilities.

What we offer you
• The possibility to contribute to the development of company-wide data direction, processes, and standards.
• Hybrid work: a mix of remote and in-office work to boost our productivity and promote a work-life balance
• To be part of a high-performing team in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
• Talented, diverse and very friendly work environment;
• A challenging project, where you can have great contribution and impact
• The fast-growing project, where you can grow and develop
• Office with a good location in Barcelona (Francesc Macià

At Shalion we’ve built a modern data platform (with technologies like Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, Looker, Airbyte and Github actions) that is critical for the company revenue generation: we sell data to our customers who consume it either through our dashboards in Looker embedded or through an API.

The role

As a Senior... Data Analyst at Shalion, your responsibilities include:
• Developing and maintaining impactful dashboards and visualizations in Looker, enhancing user experience and guiding analytical paths.
• Collaborating with Product teams to shape the product roadmap based on customer feedback and market insights.
• Translating business requirements into technical tasks, ensuring timely delivery.
• Working closely with Data Engineers to expand and enhance datasets, contributing to roadmap planning.
• Ensuring data quality and consistency across dashboards.
• Facilitating workshops for tailored business solutions and translating product questions into actionable insights.

Your profile should include the following:
• 3+ years of experience working as part of a data team; preferably as a data analyst or scientist.
• Hands-on and strong working knowledge of SQL
• High experience level with modern visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau or Qlik Sense.
• Solid statistical background.
• Experience working with Data Scientists and Engineers.

Ideally you will also have:
• An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as math, physics, computer science, statistics, etc.
• Experience with market research analysis
• Experience working with a modern data warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).
• Basic knowledge of Git and command-line
• Prior experience modelling data in LookML and dbt (data build tool)
• Be fluent with one or more common data-related programming languages (Python or R)
• UX skills

Soft Skills:
• Communication: Excellent presentation and communication skills.
• Prioritization: Skillful at prioritizing tasks, gaining stakeholder buy-in, and resolving conflicts.
• Resilience: Able to thrive in ambiguous situations and enjoy problem-solving.
• Mentorship: Interest in coaching and sharing knowledge with teammates.
• Curiosity: Eagerness to learn and engage in constructive discussions.
• Quality-oriented: Can discern data quality and value code testing for growth.
• Analytical prowess: Strong problem-solving abilities.

What we offer you
• The possibility to contribute to the development of company-wide data direction, processes, and standards.
• Hybrid work: a mix of remote and in-office work to boost our productivity and promote a work-life balance
• To be part of a high-performing team in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
• Talented, diverse and very friendly work environment;
• A challenging project, where you can have great contribution and impact
• The fast-growing project, where you can grow and develop
• Office with a good location in Barcelona (Francesc Macià

jobs_results.description:
¡knowmad mood, anteriormente atSistemas!

Si eres un apasionado/a del mundo del dato y estás en busca de un reto profesional, ¡esta oferta es para ti!

En estos momentos estamos buscando incorporar al equipo un Senior Data Analyst con experiencia en:
• Desarrollo de dashboards y conceptos en Tableau.
• Conocimientos/ experiencia de ETL.
• Experiencia en SQL.
• Conocimientos en metodología Ágil.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?
• Dar sentido a los datos y transformarlos en información útil para la toma de decisiones de las áreas de negocio.
• recopilar, limpiar y analizar los datos, generando insights de valor a las áreas comerciales y de operaciones de la compañía.
• Creación de reportes y visualizaciones que faciliten la interacción con las áreas involucradas.
• Entender e interpretar las necesidades del cliente interno, y de detectar oportunidades y riesgos a través del análisis de datos que impulsen la mejora de resultados.

¿Desde dónde trabajarás?

Híbrido (1 día de presencialidad... en las instalaciones del cliente)

knowmad mood life experience

knowmad mood es una compañía donde nos preocupamos por tu persona, tu felicidad, tu bienestar y tu salud.
• Apostamos por la formación y el desarrollo de carrera.
• Cultura human centric.
• Potenciamos engagement y la escucha activa con las personas.
• Nos preocupamos por la felicidad y el bienestar de las personas.

Work mood:
• Vacaciones: Descansa para volver con más fuerza

22 días de vacaciones + 2 días de libre disposición + 24 y 31 de diciembre.

Our mood:

Ofrecemos una nueva forma de trabajar más flexible
• Flex work: favorecemos una jornada diaria flexible para que tú decidas a tu ritmo cuándo empieza tu vida personal y cuando termina tu jornada laboral.
• Smart working: lo importante es que tú estés bien, tu desarrollo, y la orientación a resultados, no si vienes a la oficina. Por eso no hace falta ni que tengas la oficina cerca, mientras tengas una buena conexión, todo es posible.
• Beneficios y ventajas: destina parte de tu salario a determinados productos como tarjeta de transporte, tarjeta restaurante, cheques guardería, seguro médico o formación. Además disfruta en nuestra plataforma interna de todos los descuentos exclusivos para tu vida fuera de la compañía.

knowmad mood nos encargamos de cuidar a nuestras personas y es un lugar fantástico en el que trabajar, convivir y desarrollarte.
• Nos gusta escucharte: encuesta de felicidad, línea directa CEO, evaluación 360º
• Cuidamos tu bienestar: a través de nuestro programa de bienestar integral centrado en: actividad física, nutrición saludable y equilibrio emocional.
• Y de tu vida: programa de conciliación 24 horas al día y 365 días del año para ti, tu pareja y tu familia: Consultas legales, asistente personal, plan dental, consulta veterinaria, gestor administrativa
• Hacemos equipo: compartimos momentos de diversión, porque sabemos lo importante que es dedicar espacios donde conectar y reírnos más allá de los proyectos y equipos con nuestras actividades de team building:videojuegos online, scape room, ajedrez, etc
• Nos gusta juntarnos: celebramos el verano y nos reencontramos en nuestra Santa´s Summer Party.

Si tienes cualquier duda o quieres ampliar la información, no dudes en contactar con cualquiera de los compañeros de People & Talent

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst - Cliente Final - Pozuelo de Alarcón, Madrid, España
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte de una compañía internacional de restauración en plena expansión con amplias posibilidades de crecimiento?

¡Entonces sigue leyendo porque esto te interesa!

Buscamos un perfil como Data Analyst Senior para incorporarse al equipo de nuestro cliente, con sede en Pozuelo, (Madrid),

Formarás parte de un equipo de expertos en datos, desarrollando tareas de análisis de datos, procesos ETL, desarrollo de proyectos BI y reporting.

Trabajarás en un equipo innovador y comprometido con el objetivo de crear las mejores soluciones en las aplicaciones corporativas.

Esta es una oportunidad única para unirse y crecer en un entorno de rápido crecimiento, con un gran sentido de empatía con el cliente y desafíos tecnológicos.

En Digital Talent Agency te ofrecemos desarrollar proyectos en empresas destacadas del sector tecnológico, encontrando el balance perfecto entre tu vida personal y profesional.

Valoramos tu experiencia y ponemos el foco en la motivación, qué te gusta y... qué tipo de proyectos quieres participar.

Formamos parte de Zemsania Global Group y juntos, contamos con más de 20 de años de experiencia en asesoramiento profesional a candidatos y búsqueda y selección de perfiles tecnológicos.

Nuestro cliente es uno de los principales grupos de restauración en el mercado español que integra diferentes marcas ampliamente conocidas,

¿Cuáles serán las funciones que realizarás en el día a día?
• Recopilar e interpretar datos de diferentes fuentes en Azure DWH
• Analizar los resultados de diferentes acciones comerciales e impulsar insights que puedan conducir a la optimización de nuestro negocio.
• Reportar los resultados a los miembros relevantes del negocio, utilizando herramientas de visualización de datos como PowerBI.
• Desarrollo y optimización de consultas SQL (Nivel Alto).
• Experiencia en diseño de modelos de datos (Dimensional - Relacional).
• Identificar patrones y tendencias en conjuntos de datos, así como automatizar estas tareas para que podamos dedicar menos tiempo a revisar la normalidad y más tiempo a analizar patrones anómalos interesantes.
• Definir nuevos procesos de recogida y análisis de datos de nuestros diferentes verticales de negocio, como patrimonio, seguros o nuevos países.
• Localizar y definir nuevas oportunidades de mejora de procesos.
• Capacidad para identificar y automatizar tareas recurrentes (a través de scripts o paneles).
• Crear un repositorio de consultas clave (las consultas realmente útiles podrían ser interesantes para el resto del equipo y para tu trabajo futuro).
• Generar documentación de todos los procesos para facilitar su comprensión, transferencia o respaldo.

Requisitos
• Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería o campo relevante; Se prefiere un título de posgrado en TI, matemáticas, Bigdata Data u otro campo cuantitativo.
• Experiencia comprobada, mínimo 5 años, como Analista de Datos / Ingeniería,
• Sólidos conocimientos en previsión, segmentación y recomendación.
• Recopilar e interpretar datos de diferentes fuentes en Azure DWH,
• Experiencia con bases de datos SQL, como MariaDB, SQL Server y bases de datos NoSQL, como Synapse.
• Experiencia en el uso de herramientas de inteligencia empresarial (por ejemplo, Power BI) y marcos de datos.
• Buenas habilidades estadísticas aplicadas, como distribuciones, pruebas estadísticas, regresión, etc.
• Capacidad para resolver problemas.
• Buena gestión del tiempo, capacidad para cumplir bajo presión y con plazos ajustados.
• Asertivo, motivado, independiente, dinámico y orientado a resultados.
• Capacidad para construir y gestionar relaciones con las partes interesadas a nivel internacional y en todos los niveles.
• Muy valorable nivel de inglés.

Se Ofrece
• Contratación Indefinida con un cliente final, líder en la industria QSR.
• Modelo híbrido de teletrabajo / oficina ubicada en Pozuelo de Alarcón, Madrid.
• Formación idiomas / tecnología,
• Proyección laboral en una compañía en expansión.
• Salario competitivo según experiencia aportada.
• Retribución flexible,
• Y mucho más...

¡Inscríbete ahora

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Data analyst para trabajar con importante cliente en contratación inicial con KRELL.

DESCRIPCION

Ayudar a definir mejorar documentar y difundir directrices procedimientos y normas sobre análisis de datos. Entrenar y formara los equipos de Datos en Power BI y Modelo Tabular. Ser identificado como un referente en temas de Power BI. Apoyar la aparición y el advenimiento de un BI empresarial en un modelo descentralizado y desarrollar sistemas analíticos avanzados de producción. Estar en contacto con la comunidad de personas implicadas en la valorización de los Datos y apoyar su crecimiento y vivacidad

FUNCIONES
• Proporcionar directrices/mejores prácticas claras ycomunicables sobre datawarehousing modelado de datamarts cubos y reporting/dashboarding y uso de tecnologías subrayadas (AAS DAX PBI etc.) etc.
• Construir y hacer material de formación para usuarios avanzados y principiantes y aumentar la madurez general en análisis a través de AXA... Partners.
• Realizar demostraciones técnicas sobre casos de uso avanzados principalmente a través de las sesiones Guild. Apoyar la adopción de tecnologías procesos y mejores prácticas en los equipos de datos proporcionando experiencia ad-hoc y bajo demanda (fl ujos o modelado dedatos complejos rendimientos etc.).
• Auditar los desarrollos creados por los equipos de datos.
• Realizar intervenciones puntuales para los equipos de datos como miembro de los expertos ad hoc .
• Trabajar en el desarrollo despliegue yBAU de sus proyectos de análisis de datos.
• Apoyar a los equipos de datos en sus actividades diarias siempre que necesiten ayuda.
• Ser un actor clave en las ceremonias de scrum y asegurarse junto con los demás miembros del equipo de datos de que se respetan los pilares de scrum.

Must have skills
• BI
• Power BI
• SQL
• Inglés C1

Nice to have skills
• Azure DevOps
• Scrum
• Azure Cloud Datalake Databricks Spark o NoSQL DB

QUE OFRECEMOS
• Contrato indefinido en plantilla y puestos de larga duración.
• Acceso a compañía consolidada con proyectos a muy alto nivel tecnológico y en diferentes sectores.
• Encontrarás un entorno de trabajo dinámico e integrador.
• Trabajo remoto

Modalidad hibrida. Ubicación en Barcelona (Teletrabajo60 - presencial 40 .)

¡Te estamos esperando! ¡Inscríbete y da un salto en tu carrera!
